text:
INT. KITCHEN - DAWN

A book of MATCHES sits between them. ELI strikes one, lets it burn to the fingertip, pinches it out.

LENA
You still leave the window open.

ELI
Only when I expect company that knocks.

LENA
I brought coffee. Not an apology.

ELI
Then don't set it where the matches are.

Lena slides the cup left. Eli slides the matchbook right. Neither drinks. The next match stays unstruck.
